rawContent: It wasn't just that. for me. It was how flagrantly @SenGillibrand was making a political calculation to leverage #Metoo for HER political advantage, thus not only being unfair to @AlFranken, but also politicizing something that had previously been mostly an apolitical issue.

.@SenGillibrand was among the first to weaponize #metoo in politics. We're going to be seeing it used this way for years to come.  Every upside has a down. But hey, at this point, it's harder to find people without a grift than to find people with one.

By our new post-#metoo standards, as interpretted by @lucyFlores & Sanders supporters,  @Joebiden is a sexual predator who should be on every sex offender watch list. 

But by the standards of 2014, he's just sort of like everyone's Uncle Joe at best, or their fathers at worst.
